newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Livshits hopes for DeBeers deal - agency.
newsitem.headline: Livshits hopes for DeBeers deal - agency.

text.p: Interfax news agency quoted Russian Finance Minister Alexander Livshits as saying on Thursday that he was confident Russia would sign a new trade agreement with De Beers.
It also quoted him as saying Russia's diamond industry depended on mutually beneficial relations with international organisations, including with De Beers.

Livshits, who is also a deputy prime minister, said his comments reflected government opinion and that the trade agreement would answer the interests of all those in the diamond business, including Russia. He gave no further details.
The Finance Ministry earlier on Thursday issued a statement saying Russia was ready to cooperate with De Beers.

De Beers, frustrated over Russia's months-long delay in approving or rejecting a trade agreement, on Wednesday gave the government until the end of 1996 to approve a diamond export deal and said it would otherwise terminate an interim arrangement.
The ministry plays a significant role in approving or rejecting the agreement, which must ultimately be signed by Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
